name: Chocolate Cake
description: Indulge in our rich, moist double-layered cake made with premium Dutch cocoa and buttermilk. It is baked to perfection and smothered in a silky ganache made from heavy cream and dark chocolate chips.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake
description: A velvety New York-style cheesecake featuring a buttery graham cracker crust. It is slow-baked with real cream cheese and Madagascar vanilla, then topped with a homemade glaze using fresh, sun-ripened local strawberries.

name: Vanilla Ice Cream
description: Our classic churned ice cream is made with a rich custard base of organic milk, heavy cream, and egg yolks. Infused with real vanilla bean specks, it offers a timeless, smooth, and creamy finish.

name: Brownie
description: This dense, fudgy brownie is crafted with melted unsalted butter and high-quality dark chocolate. It is hand-mixed with sea salt and chocolate chunks, then baked until the center is perfectly soft and gooey.

name: Tiramisu
description: An authentic Italian masterpiece featuring ladyfinger biscuits soaked in bold espresso and rum. Layered with a whipped mascarpone cheese mixture and dusted with fine cocoa powder, it is chilled to allow flavors to meld.

name: Lemon Tart
description: A zesty delight featuring a crisp shortcrust pastry shell filled with tangy lemon curd. Made from fresh-squeezed lemon juice, zest, butter, and sugar, it is lightly baked to create a refreshing, vibrant treat.

name: Apple Pie
description: Traditional comfort in every bite, our pie features a flaky, hand-folded crust. It is stuffed with Granny Smith apples seasoned with cinnamon and nutmeg, then baked until the fruit is tender and golden brown.

name: Chocolate Mousse
description: Experience an airy, light texture in this sophisticated dessert. Prepared by folding whipped egg whites into a mixture of melted bittersweet chocolate and heavy cream, it provides an intense cocoa experience in every spoonful.

name: Caramel Pudding
description: A smooth, silken custard made from whole milk and sugar, gently steamed to a perfect wobble. It is served with a generous coating of amber-colored caramel sauce, made by slowly caramelizing sugar and water.

name: Red Velvet Cake
description: A vibrant, cocoa-infused cake with a subtle tang from buttermilk and vinegar. Layers are baked to a soft crumb and frosted with a rich, tangy cream cheese icing made with butter and powdered sugar.

name: Espresso
description: A concentrated, bold coffee shot extracted under high pressure. We use finely ground Arabica beans and filtered water to create a rich, full-bodied flavor profile topped with a thick, golden layer of natural crema.

name: Americano
description: For those who enjoy a smoother, longer coffee experience. We combine a double shot of our signature espresso with hot purified water, preserving the complex notes of the coffee bean while mellowing the intensity.

name: Cappuccino
description: A perfect balance of strength and creaminess. This drink is crafted with equal parts espresso, steamed whole milk, and deep, airy milk foam, resulting in a rich texture that is often finished with cocoa.

name: Latte
description: Our smoothest coffee choice, made with a generous amount of steamed milk poured over a single or double shot of espresso. It is finished with a light layer of micro-foam for a silky mouthfeel.

name: Mocha
description: A delicious blend for chocolate lovers. We combine our premium espresso with artisanal chocolate sauce and steamed milk. This beverage offers a harmonious mix of caffeine and sweet cocoa, topped with a velvety foam.

name: Flat White
description: Originating from the South Pacific, this drink features a double shot of ristretto espresso. It is blended with a thin layer of velvety micro-foamed milk, creating a stronger coffee flavor with a creamy texture.

name: Macchiato
description: A 'stained' coffee experience for purists. We start with a bold shot of espresso and add just a small dollop of frothed milk on top, softening the edge of the espresso without diluting its strength.

name: Iced Latte
description: Chilled and refreshing, this drink is made by pouring fresh espresso over cold whole milk and ice cubes. It is a crisp, clean way to enjoy your daily caffeine with a smooth, milky finish.

name: Cold Brew
description: Slow-steeped for 24 hours in cool filtered water, this method extracts the natural sweetness of the coffee beans. The result is a low-acid, high-caffeine beverage with a incredibly smooth and chocolatey flavor profile.

name: Caramel Latte
description: Our classic latte elevated with a swirl of rich, buttery caramel syrup. Made with espresso and steamed milk, it is finished with a drizzle of salted caramel sauce for an extra touch of sweetness.

name: Orange Juice
description: Start your day with a burst of vitamin C. Our juice is freshly squeezed every morning using 100% ripe Valencia oranges, ensuring a sweet and tangy flavor with absolutely no added sugars or preservatives.

name: Lemonade
description: A nostalgic summer classic made with real squeezed lemons, filtered water, and just the right amount of cane sugar. It is shaken with ice to create a crisp, refreshing drink that balances tart and sweet.

name: Iced Tea
description: Brewed from premium black tea leaves and chilled instantly to lock in flavor. This sugar-free beverage is served over ice with a fresh lemon wedge, offering a clean, brisk taste that is incredibly revitalizing.

name: Mango Smoothie
description: Transport yourself to the tropics with this thick, creamy blend. We use frozen honey mango chunks, Greek yogurt, and a splash of honey, blended until perfectly smooth for a naturally sweet and filling drink.

name: Strawberry Smoothie
description: A vibrant blend of fresh strawberries, creamy milk, and a touch of agave nectar. This smoothie is whipped at high speed to create a frothy, pink delight that is both healthy and satisfyingly sweet.

name: Apple Juice
description: Pure and simple, our apple juice is cold-pressed from a blend of Gala and Fuji apples. It contains no artificial colors or additives, providing the crisp, sweet taste of a fresh orchard harvest.

name: Peach Iced Tea
description: Our signature black iced tea infused with natural peach nectar. It is lightly sweetened with cane syrup and served with a slice of fresh peach, offering a fruity twist on a classic chilled favorite.

name: Berry Smoothie
description: An antioxidant-rich powerhouse featuring a mix of blueberries, raspberries, and blackberries. Blended with almond milk and a hint of vanilla, this smoothie is a tart and delicious way to fuel your afternoon.

name: Pineapple Juice
description: Experience the bold, sunny flavor of the tropics. Our pineapple juice is extracted from ripe, golden pineapples, resulting in a naturally sweet and slightly acidic drink that is best served ice-cold.

name: Coconut Smoothie
description: A creamy, exotic treat made with real coconut milk, shredded coconut, and a base of frozen banana for texture. It is a dairy-free delight that is subtly sweet and remarkably refreshing on a hot day.

name: Butter Croissant
description: A true French classic featuring dozens of paper-thin layers. Made with high-quality fermented butter and wheat flour, these are hand-laminated and baked daily to achieve a shattered-crisp exterior and a soft, airy interior.

name: Chocolate Croissant
description: Also known as Pain au Chocolat, this buttery pastry is filled with two batons of semi-sweet dark chocolate. The golden, flaky dough melts in your mouth, perfectly complementing the rich chocolate center.

name: Cinnamon Roll
description: Soft, pillowy yeast dough swirled with a generous filling of Saigon cinnamon and brown sugar. After baking to a light brown, it is drizzled with a decadent cream cheese glaze while still warm.

name: Blueberry Muffin
description: Baked with a cake-like batter and bursting with fresh whole blueberries. These muffins are topped with a light sprinkle of coarse demerara sugar for a delightful crunch on top of the moist fruit center.

name: Almond Danish
description: A flaky pastry nest filled with sweet almond frangipane cream. It is topped with toasted sliced almonds and a light dusting of powdered sugar, offering a nutty, sophisticated flavor and a satisfying crunch.

name: Cheese Danish
description: Our Danish pastry dough is folded with layers of butter and filled with a sweet, tangy cream cheese center. It’s a perfect morning treat that balances the richness of the pastry with a smooth filling.

name: Apple Turnover
description: Triangular puff pastry envelopes filled with spiced apple compote. These are baked until they reach a deep golden color and are finished with a light sugar glaze, creating a portable version of apple pie.

name: Chocolate Muffin
description: A double chocolate treat made with premium cocoa powder and loaded with Belgian chocolate chips. The batter is enriched with sour cream to ensure a dense, moist texture that satisfies any chocolate craving.

name: Strawberry Danish
description: Laminated pastry dough shaped into a square and filled with a combination of vanilla custard and fresh strawberry jam. It is baked until golden and topped with a whole glazed strawberry for decoration.

name: Hazelnut Croissant
description: A decadent twist on our butter croissant, filled with a rich chocolate-hazelnut spread. The exterior is garnished with chopped hazelnuts and a chocolate drizzle, providing a nutty and sweet finish to every bite.

name: Hot Chocolate
description: Not your average cocoa; this is made by melting real milk chocolate into steamed whole milk. It is whisked until frothy and served warm, often topped with mini marshmallows or a cloud of whipped cream.

name: Green Tea
description: Sourced from high-altitude tea gardens, these whole green tea leaves are steeped in 80-degree water to prevent bitterness. The resulting brew is light, earthy, and packed with natural antioxidants for a healthy boost.

name: Black Tea
description: A robust and full-bodied tea made from fermented Assam leaves. Steeped in boiling water, it offers a deep amber color and a malty flavor profile that pairs beautifully with a splash of milk.

name: Chamomile Tea
description: A soothing, caffeine-free herbal infusion made from dried chamomile flowers. When steeped in hot water, it releases a delicate floral aroma and a slight honey-like sweetness, perfect for relaxation and evening enjoyment.

name: Matcha Latte
description: Finely ground ceremonial-grade Japanese green tea whisked with hot water and combined with creamy steamed milk. This vibrant green beverage offers a unique umami flavor balanced by a gentle, natural sweetness.

name: Chai Latte
description: A warming blend of sweetened black tea infused with aromatic spices like cardamom, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves. It is mixed with steamed milk to create a spicy, creamy, and comforting drink.

name: Peppermint Tea
description: Refreshingly cool and caffeine-free, our peppermint tea is made from dried peppermint leaves. The steep produces a clear, minty infusion that aids digestion and provides a crisp, clean taste after any meal.

name: Honey Lemon Tea
description: A comforting remedy in a cup. We steep black tea with fresh lemon slices and stir in a generous spoonful of organic wildflower honey, creating a soothing balance of citrus tartness and floral sweetness.

name: Ginger Tea
description: Made by simmering fresh ginger root in filtered water. This spicy, invigorating infusion is served hot and is known for its warming properties and bold, peppery flavor that awakens the senses.

name: Turmeric Latte
description: Often called 'Golden Milk,' this healthy latte combines steamed coconut milk with turmeric, ginger, and black pepper. It is lightly sweetened and offers an earthy, spiced flavor profile with numerous wellness benefits.
